name: Move-out sale
summary: Friends claim a mover's things before the sale goes public, then hold their haul for pickup.
useWhen: someone in the chat is moving out and selling furniture and things to friends first
'I'm selling everything before I move', 'dibs on the couch', 'friends first, then Marketplace'
dontUseWhen: the group buying one listing together (use group-buy)
a single item price question (use price-check)
giving things away for free with no pickup (use a claim list)

seller.description: Who is moving, exactly as in the members list

claimedBy.description: Who already called it, by name, or empty

note.description: A line from the seller: 'bring a dolly lol', or empty
